name: Codestral
short: Mistral's original 22B open-weight code model (`codestral-2405`, 2024): low-latency fill-in-the-middle autocomplete across 80+ languages at 32K context; the live `codestral` alias now redirects to Codestral 25.08.
modalities: Text, code in; text, code out
pricingNote: Source-available weights; `codestral-2405` is deprecated — the live alias resolves to Codestral 25.08.
pricingTiers: Historical La Plateforme API ~$0.30/$0.90 per 1M in/out (now redirected to codestral-2508)
standout: The model that started Mistral's code line — SOTA FIM autocomplete at launch (HumanEval 81.1, FIM pass@1 91.8) from a light 22B.
tradeoff: A superseded 2024 release: 32K window, no reasoning/agentic modes, no independent AA row — the live alias now points to 25.08, so this bare slug risks conflation with `codestral-25.08`.
